glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 其 + semantic 日. The original composition with the semantic 日 (“sun”) is preserved in the variant forms 㫷 and 𣇳. The sun then changed to 月 (“moon”) to produce 朞, from which the character then evolved to the current form.
senses: to arrange a time; to engage; to arrange to meet
[jī] (obsolete) whole year; entire month; one-year anniversary
